pitLanes.modeReason: closed for now, though it could be drivable (a straight, parallel lane beside Senna Straight, no short cut: 0.3 m): a car in the lane would miss the finish checkpoint (it spans the track only) and the track's barrier plan has no gaps for the merges yet
pitLanes.widthSource: estimated from the gap between the track's edge and the pit building (OSM 145755929, LIDAR)
